newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa to publish insider trading report Thurs.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa to publish insider trading report Thurs.

text.p: A government-appointed task force will publish a keenly-awaited report on insider trading in South Africa next Thursday, officials said.
The Insider Trading Task Group, headed by Mervyn King, will present its findings to the government which could produce legislation in 1998.
South Africa is burdened with a reputation as a haven for insider trading, highlighted by several high-profile cases of trading in company shares ahead of major announcements.
Insider trading is a criminal offence, with penalties of up to 10 years in prison and fines of up to 500,000 rand. But there has never been a conviction.
